articles.title: Can KONE (HLSE:KNEBV) Stock Justify Its Premium After Q3 Results?
articles.summary: KONE came into Q3 2026 priced for perfection, trading on a rich P/E multiple and backed by a long running elevator and escalator quality story. The company then reported quarterly figures that showed adjusted EBIT of €369m on €2,906m of sales and a 40 basis point lift in margin, yet the stock closed today at €54.68 with only modest recent gains. For anyone owning or eyeing KONE, the focus is not the headline revenue line. It is the profit resilience and cash flow of about €1.3b year to date...

articles.title: Kone Oyj Unsponsored ADR (KNYJY) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Miss Estimates
articles.summary: Kone Oyj (KNYJY) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -3.23% and -0.59%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

articles.title: KONE shares fall over 3% despite higher Q3 sales and improved adjusted earnings
articles.summary: Investing.com -- KONE Oyj (HE:KNEBV) shares fell over 3% on Wednesday after the Finnish elevator maker reported higher third-quarter sales and adjusted earnings, while raising the lower end of its full-year revenue growth forecast and narrowing its operating margin outlook.

articles.title: Is KONE Oyj (HLSE:KNEBV) Undervalued Following Its Pune Digital Experience Centre Launch?
articles.summary: KONE Oyj (HLSE:KNEBV) has opened a Digital Experience Centre in Pune, India, giving customers a live view of how its AI, connectivity, and data tools shape elevator and smart building solutions. The Digital Experience Centre launch lands at a time when KONE Oyj’s short-term share price momentum is picking up, with a 30-day share price return of 6.39% and a 90-day gain of 6.93%. However, the year-to-date share price is still down 13.09%, and the 1-year total shareholder return has declined...

articles.title: Citi turns bullish on Kone as share slump leaves TKE deal unpriced
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Citi Research upgraded elevator maker Kone to "buy" from "neutral" with a €63 price target, saying the shares’ fall since February means they price in only a very low probability of its proposed Thyssenkrupp Elevator acquisition.
